rejection_reason: attribution: credit is purely engineering, not designer. All public credits describe Perry as 'creator of Motion' / 'Author of Motion' / 'software engineer at Framer' / 'Founder - Motion' / 'Senior Software Engineer - Framer' (motion.dev/about, GitHub bio, LinkedIn, X bio, oss.institute, devtools.fm, syntax.fm, jackvaughan.com). No third-party source credits him as a designer on a shipped design tool: at Framer he was an engineer (created Framer Motion, the animation library), CSS Studio is credited 'From the creators of Motion' (creator credit, not designer credit), and Motion's visual design is self-disclosed only. His designer background (print/web designer early career, redesigned motion.dev himself) is self-disclosed (Tier 3) in interviews (Syntax.fm Nov 2024; devtools.fm 2025; Jack Vaughan podcast 2025) and is not a public credit on a shipped product. Per wave spec instruction, purely-engineering credit => REJECT on attribution even though scale is huge.
